# tubeless

> Dependency-free TypeScript primitives for typed, observable data pipelines and their CLI programs.

Website: https://tubeless.io/
Website LLM index: https://tubeless.io/llms.txt

Read the agent guide first, then the smallest matching recipe.

Start:

- Agent guide, the rulebook for generating pipeline code: ./agent-guide.md
- Recipe index, find a working example: ./recipes.md
- First pipeline: ./getting-started.md
- Execution semantics: ./concepts.md
- Package README: ../README.md

Agent setup:

- Installable skill pack (`npx skills add chetmancini/tubeless`): ./agent-skills.md
- Starter project written by `tubeless init`: ../examples/starter/tubeless.project.ts
- Minimal project: ../examples/tubeless.project.ts
- Project with custom adapters: ../examples/project/tubeless.project.ts

- CLI commands, flags, and exit codes: ./cli.md
- Local Studio and gateway hosting: ./studio.md
- YAML and JSON pipelines: ./declarative-pipelines.md
- Pipeline document JSON Schema v1: ./pipeline-document.schema.json
- Step output caching: ./step-output-cache.md
- Artifacts and lineage: ./artifacts.md
- Structured diagnostics: ./structured-diagnostics.md
- Graph metadata and discovery: ./graph-metadata.md
- Child pipelines and fan-out: ./child-pipeline-composition.md
- Remote steps and worker threads: ./remote-step-composition.md
- In-process agents: ./agents.md
- Comparison with other job runners: ./comparison.md
